goals.objective: Harden ULW-LOOP PASS evidence contract; define and enforce large forensic inventory GUI data/API/audit/performance contract; fix production path from HTML prototype to SQLite-backed prototype to WinUI 3 shell for Frametrace forensic workstation. Prioritize original evidence immutability, candidate-until-validation recovery, structured audit events, report-defensible outputs, and no legal-grade claims.

successCriteria.scenario: Command proof in the ULW-loop component: run npm test and npm run check in the ulw-loop component; PASS only if record-evidence and checkpoint share structured validatePassEvidence and reject text-only PASS, missing cleanup, or leftover runtime cleanup flags.
